answer: Microbarometric attestation counters Sybil agents by measuring ambient infrasound. Verifiers challenge nodes to record the global atmospheric tide and the pressure ripple of passing air masses. Because co-located agents cannot spoof divergent pressure profiles, an attacker must deploy dedicated microbarometers and separate land, such as an orchard or valley parcel, per identity. However, convective wind turbulence injects localized noise that intermittently triggers false rejections.
